contract.policy: same frozen E17/W8/E33; original E29 per-request vs measured singleton vs joint expected tokens / batch wall
contract.direct: after both first tokens through terminal/native retirement; first draft included, prefill excluded
contract.service: same default CUDA stream and SSE handler; cohort after both first outputs, full request separately
contract.comparison: widths and acceptance traces may change; final greedy tokens and eager logits/features/state must match
contract.costs: frozen before evaluation; no fitting on evaluation outcomes; frozen paid W8 draft cost per actual drafted request

cost_calibration.timing: host launch through completed verify/head/commit and retirement; state restore, draft, prefill and warmup excluded
cost_calibration.cost: physical 1/2/4/8 buckets; candidate head variability approximated, not an exact cost for every token prefix
cost_calibration.commit: retain one token per active window, all original fences retained
cost_calibration.calibration: synthetic lease/retry context separate from timed generation prompts; frozen before evaluation

resident.allocation_note: Any incremental32MiB blocks are library workspace attribution from allocator evidence, not live request tensors

decision: Keep original independent E17 budgets as default. Joint measured costs are explicit opt-in; no 4-request or full K5 completion claim.
limitations: Three formal repetitions; four separate instrumented probe repetitions, no broad workload/latency guarantee.
Physical-bucket costs approximate candidate-dependent head work and commit behavior; two context anchors 64/1024.
Frozen per-request W8 paid costs retained; no concurrent DFlash computation or four-request execution added.
Changed widths imply changed acceptance trajectories; compare greedy tokens and same-position E17 probabilities, not identical round traces.
Probe API times overlap, include prefill, and cannot be summed; CPU entry/exit samples do not establish a scheduling cause.
Formal SSE regresses; favorable direct results alone cannot promote the serving policy.
